description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Plugins_DeliveryLog' which serves as a base for plugin components that utilize the deliveryLog extension in the Revive Adserver project. It includes constants, properties, constructor logic for strategy pattern, abstract methods for dependency management and table info, and concrete methods for migration validation, data retrieval, and delegation of processing strategies.
